```{r results='hide', echo=FALSE}
#The following defines a convenience function for loading libraries, installing if necessary.
loadLibrary = function(packageName, suppressMessages = TRUE, githubRepo = NULL)
 {
  if (! require(packageName, character.only = TRUE)) {
    if (! is.null(githubRepo)) {
      loadLibrary("devtools")
      devtools::install_github(githubRepo)    
    }
    else 
      install.packages(packageName)
  
    if (suppressMessages)
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(packageName, character.only = TRUE))
    else 
      library(packageName, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}  
```

```{r}
source("DataloaderE3.R")
fd <- getFactCheckTestDataV2()
trialData <- fd$trials

columns_to_convert <- c("credibilitySection", "slider-share-start", "prior","sharingSection","trialStartTime","share","commentChoiceSection","trialEndTime","slider-pre-start")
trialData[, columns_to_convert] <- lapply(trialData[, columns_to_convert], as.numeric)

trialData <- trialData %>% mutate(credTime = (sharingSection - credibilitySection)/1000, 
                     shareTime= (trialEndTime - sharingSection)/1000,
                     commentChoiceTime = (credibilitySection-commentChoiceSection)/1000,
                     duration = duration/1000,
                     confidence = ifelse(commentChoice == 'commentCorrect', (100-prior),prior),
                     commentCategory = ifelse(commentChoice %in% c('commentAgree','commentDisagree'),'reinforce', ifelse(commentChoice == 'commentCorrect','corrective','skip')))
```

```{r}
#how many participants? 
durationSummary<-  trialData %>% select(uid, duration, credTime,shareTime,commentChoiceTime) %>% group_by(uid) %>% summarize(meanTrialDuration = mean(duration, trim=.25), meanCredT = mean(credTime, trim=.25), meanShareT = mean(shareTime, trim=.25), meanComT = mean(commentChoiceTime, trim=.25))

durationSummary
```

```{r}
trialData %>% filter(uid == 'EtHvQBnzal6eGzsra0S6')

```

```{r}
trialData %>% filter(uid == 'QuD5AiEsJ3mNn4dQvnLV')
```

```{r}
countSummary <- trialData %>% group_by(uid) %>%
  # Summarize counts for each category (using dplyr's summarise function)
  summarise(
    disagree_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentDisagree"),
    correct_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentCorrect"),
    agree_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentAgree"),
    skip_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentSkip")
  )

countSummary <- countSummary %>% mutate(total = (disagree_count + correct_count + agree_count + skip_count), skipPerc = (skip_count/total)*100, affirmPerc = ((disagree_count+agree_count)/total)*100, correctPerc = (correct_count/total)*100)

countSummary
```

```{r}
summary <- merge(countSummary, durationSummary, by = "uid")
```

```{r}
summary
```

## Headline Analysis

```{r}
headLineData <- trialData %>% select(mainHeadline, groundTruth,prior, share,commentChoice) %>% group_by(mainHeadline, groundTruth) %>% summarise(meanCred = mean(prior), meanShare = mean(share), disagree_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentDisagree") , correct_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentCorrect"), agree_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentAgree"), skip_count = sum(commentChoice == "commentSkip"))

headLineData
```

Did the design work? Do credibility ratings agree with comment choices?

```{r}
trialData %>% select(uid, commentChoice, prior, mainHeadline) %>% filter(commentChoice == 'commentCorrect' & prior >= 50)
```

```{r}
trialData %>% select(uid, commentChoice, prior, mainHeadline) %>% filter(commentChoice == "commentDisagree" & prior < 50)
```

```{r}
trialData %>% select(uid, commentChoice, prior, mainHeadline) %>% filter(commentChoice == "commentAgree" & prior < 50)
```

8.75% of the comments do not match their credibility ratings.

```{r}
credSummary <- trialData %>% select(commentChoice, prior) %>% group_by(commentChoice) %>% summarise(count = n(),meanCred = mean(prior),  sd = sd(prior),se = sd/sqrt(count),ci = se * qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, count-1))

credSummary
```

```{r}
ggplot(credSummary, aes(x=commentChoice, y=meanCred)) + 
    geom_bar(position=position_dodge(), stat="identity", width = .7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=meanCred-ci, ymax=meanCred+ci),
                  width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                  position=position_dodge(.7)) + 
   ylab("Mean credibility rating") + xlab("Choice of Comments") + 
   theme_bw() + ggtitle('Credibility ratings given to comment choices')
```

```{r}
catSummary <- trialData %>% select(commentCategory, confidence) %>% group_by(commentCategory) %>% summarise(count = n(),mean = mean(confidence),  sd = sd(confidence),se = sd/sqrt(count),ci = se * qt((1-0.05)/2 + .5, count-1))

catSummary
```

```{r}
ggplot(catSummary, aes(x=commentCategory, y=mean)) + 
    geom_bar(position=position_dodge(), stat="identity", width = .7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-ci, ymax=mean+ci),
                  width=.2,                    # Width of the error bars
                  position=position_dodge(.7)) + 
   ylab("Mean confidence rating") + xlab("Comment Type") + 
   theme_bw() + ggtitle('Confidence ratings given by comment type')
```

```{r}
ggplot(trialData, aes(x=prior, fill=commentCategory)) + geom_density(alpha=0.5) + xlab("Credibility ratings given to online comments") + ylab("Density")
```

```{r}
trialData$commentChoice <- as.factor(trialData$commentChoice)
trialData$commentCategory <- as.factor(trialData$commentCategory)
goodnessOfFitTest(trialData$commentCategory)
```

```{r}
goodnessOfFitTest(trialData$commentChoice)
```

```{r}
temp <- trialData %>% filter(commentCategory %in% c('corrective', 'reinforce')) %>% select(commentCategory, groundTruth) %>% mutate(classification = ifelse( groundTruth == 'FALSE' & commentCategory == 'corrective', 'hit',
                                         ifelse(groundTruth == 'FALSE' & commentCategory != 'corrective', 'miss',
                                                ifelse(groundTruth == 'TRUE' & commentCategory == 'reinforce', 'hit','miss'))))

temp$commentCategory <- factor(temp$commentCategory)
table(temp %>% select(commentCategory, classification))
```

```{r}
prop.test(table(temp %>% select(commentCategory, classification)))
```
